name: Pi Agent Adapter
summary: Official Pi extension package for the governed Meshrix MCP connector.

integration.sourceBoundary: Repository-local optional adapter using only the public Meshrix MCP connector boundary.
coveredCapabilities: Pi MCP tool discovery and invocation

notes: The plugin configuration contains connector metadata only.
Credentials remain in the Core-managed private credential store.
The plugin never accepts raw tokens in configuration or process arguments.
